title: The settings layers' gate_checks run in kbgit.py sync --push and in backlog.py done after the shipped checks, and a failing one refuses naming its command
goal: kg_sync.group_gate(root) runs each argv of gate_checks from kbsettings.layered without a shell from the repository root with a timeout each; it returns the failures, each naming its argv, its layer and its exit code; kbgit.py sync --push refuses the push on a failure after the shipped gate, exit 1; backlog.py done refuses the item on a failure; with no gate_checks group_gate returns no failure so both run as before

clauses.clause: kg_sync.group_gate(root) runs each argv of gate_checks from kbsettings.layered without a shell from the repository root with a timeout each
